senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A certain person or thing, any thing or person referred to without a name.
E.
अमु for अदस् this, and वज added.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Not loosed, not let go.
2 Not liberated from birth and death.
n. (-क्तं)
A weapon that is always grasped to be used, as a knife, &c. See मुक्तामुक्त, यन्त्रामुक्त, &c.
E.
अ neg. and मुक्त released.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Loosed, let go.
2 Discharged, cast, shot.
3 Put on as clothes or armour.
4 Dressed, accoutred.
E.
आङ्, मुच् to release, unbind, &c. क्त aff.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
Sparing, frugal, prudent.
E.
अमुक्त not loosed, हस्त the hand.

f. (-क्तिः)
Confinement, want of freedom or liberty.
E.
अ neg. मुक्ति liberation.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Liberation, being let loose.
2 Final liberation.
ind. (-क्ति)
To the end of existence.
E.
आङ् and मुक्ति liberation.

mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं)
Inferior, ordinary.
E.
अ neg. मुख्य principal.

ind.
Hence, from this.
E.
अमु for अदस् and तसिल् aff.

ind.
In the next life.
E.
अमु from अदस् this or that, and त्रल् aff.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Belonging to a future state, being of the next world.
E.
अमुत्र and त्य aff.

mf. (-त्रः-त्री)
1 Of a good family, of known origin.
2 The son or daughter of such a one.
E.
अमुष्य the irr. gen. of अदस् this, and पुत्र a son, &c.

mf. (-णः-णा)
1 Of respectable birth, of known origin.
2 The offspring of such a one, of a certain person, &c.
E.
अमुष्य as in the last, and फक् affix, also आमुष्यायण.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Of an illustrious family, well born, well descended.
E.
अमुष्य the genitive of अदस् this, and कक् aff.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Of such form or kind.
E.
अमू for अदस् this, and क्किप् affix; also अमूदृश and अमूदृक्ष.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Of such a form or kind.
E.
see the last.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Such, like, of such form or kind.
E.
see अमूदृश.

mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Formless, shapeless, unembodied.
E.
अ neg. मूर्त्ति form; the final changed.

f. (-र्त्तिः)
Shapelessness, absence of shape or form.
E.
अ neg. मूर्त्ति form.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Having no root. Also अमूलक
f. (-ला)
A plant. See अग्निशिखा.
E.
अ neg. and मूल a root.

adv. n. (-लं)
To the root, by the root, entirely, radically.
E.
आङ् particle, and मूल root.

mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
Invaluable, not to be purchased.
E.
अ neg. मूल्य price.

n. (-खं)
1 Prelude, prologue.
2 Commencement.
ind.
To the face.
E.
आङ् before मुख face or beginning.

m. (-पः)
A thorny kind of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa, Rox.)
